handoff.context: Caller explicitly asks to be put through to a human who knows IVF coverage details.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Meera calling from Niva Bupa — I help families find the right health cover. Is now a good time for a quick chat?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Who are you looking to get covered — just yourself, or family too?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Family of four, oldest is 48, we're in Chennai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks — that covers a lot. Does anyone in the family have any existing health conditions, like diabetes or blood pressure?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Does the policy cover IVF treatment after two failed cycles?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have a clear answer on IVF coverage after failed cycles. Let me get a colleague who can check that for you — is this number okay to call back?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's not good enough, I need an actual answer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, and I'm sorry I can't give you that answer on this line. A colleague who can check the exact IVF terms will call you back shortly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then put me through to someone who knows.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course — I'm connecting you with a colleague who can walk you through the IVF coverage details.
